definitions.explanation: Concentric circular waves spreading outward from a point of disturbance on a water surface.
The spreading impact or consequences of an event, especially something controversial or disruptive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{波紋|はもん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Ripples spread when I threw a stone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水面|すいめん}→水面：04307_suimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{波紋|はもん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Beautiful ripples formed on the water's surface.

examples.japanese: ⟦{池|いけ}→池：00848_ike⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{波紋|はもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}いた→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: A leaf that fell into the pond traced small ripples.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{波紋|はもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}んだ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: That remark caused a big stir.

examples.japanese: ⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{波紋|はもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げた→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧。
examples.english: The news of the resignation sent ripples through the political world.

notes:
WRITING:
{波|は} (wave) + ⟦{紋|もん}→紋：13863_mon⟧ (pattern). Literally "wave pattern."

USAGE:
The figurative sense (sense 2) is extremely common in news and formal writing, often in the set phrase {波紋|はもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (to cause a stir/repercussions) or {波紋|はもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧ (to spread repercussions).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {波紋|はもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to cause a stir
- {波紋|はもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: to spread ripples/repercussions
- {波紋|はもん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: ripples/repercussions spread
- {波紋|はもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げかける→投げかける：28968_nagekakeru⟧: to cause ripple effects
